titel: Hats of the Fallen, Steam header v4 (920x430, kelder onder het bureaublad) tegen Rusty's Retirement, Spirit City: Lofi Sessions en Desktop Defender
rol: You play cozy idle games on PC while you work or study. You want a small game that lives on your desktop or at the bottom of your screen. You are scrolling the Steam store and only see the small header image of each game. Pick the game you would click on first.
